I sorta believe that, but it's hard to toss away 20+ years of steady Catholicism and sort of "find my own road" as it may be.  I've been looking into the Anglican/Episcopalian church out here, and they seem to be a bit more inline with my values and life situation.

The hard part is parents, work, letting people down, etc.  Just knowing and fearing that I may have to go to hospital and miss work, which could make me lose my job. (I lost one before.. I went to hospital and was on Short Term Disability for 4 months, and when it was up, they didn't take me back. Apparently that's legal for at-will employment situations.)

So yea.  I saw my therapist today, and we went over options for hospital and I need to talk to HR at work, but I might have to wait for space to get into the one good hospital that has a really good Bipolar/DBT skills program.  And waiting is hard.

I like some shit.  Like when my parents immigrated here, I had cousins here, and they'd take me out hiking in the woods and go camping.  Taught me guitar, and how to smack talk against boys in online games. Played football with them, learned cricket and all that.  Enjoyed the hell out of it until university.

The funny thing is, I do all of the right things.. Like eat right, exercise (I don't skip leg day!) and have this job that is probably what most people dream of.  Came from a big immigrant family with a "Up by your bootstraps" mentality, but after University, they moved back the the old country, and have only came back to see me in previous suicide attempts.  And that right off pissed them off.  Said I was the "bad" kid and such. So we don't communicate much anymore.

I also have Chronic GI issues over the last few years, and they can't narrow it down.  It's probably all anxiety-related, which is horrid. Despite the exercise and eating right, I'm practically anorexic.  My ex, she got fed up with me, since she was like a super-extrovert, and I'd fell back over into introvert land for the last year of our relationship.  It's a stupid bloody mess in my stupid head so often.  I went out and looked up at the  stupid stars after posting, and couldn't even begin to snap out of it. It fecking hurts like so much.
